INSERT INTO svc_mbr_session ( session_id, mbr_id, ip_addr, user_agent, brwsr_info, device_type, os_info, actv_yn ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{mbrId}, #{ipAddr}, #{userAgent}, #{brwsrInfo}, #{deviceType}, #{osInfo}, 'Y' )
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO svc_mbr_session_concurrent_users_cnt (concurrent_users_cnt) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM svc_mbr_session WHERE actv_yn = 'Y') + 1 AS concurrent_users_cnt
mapper.update: UPDATE svc_mbr_session SET last_act_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND actv_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT session_sn, session_id, mbr_id, session_start_dt, session_end_dt, ip_addr, brwsr_info, device_type, os_info, actv_yn, last_act_dt FROM svc_mbr_session WHERE mbr_id = #{mbrId} AND actv_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY session_start_dt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT session_sn, session_id, mbr_id, session_start_dt, session_end_dt, ip_addr, brwsr_info, device_type, os_info, actv_yn, last_act_dt FROM svc_mbr_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT s.session_sn, s.session_id, s.mbr_id, s.session_start_dt, s.last_act_dt, s.ip_addr, s.brwsr_info, s.device_type, s.os_info FROM svc_mbr_session s LEFT JOIN persistent_logins p ON s.session_id = p.session_id WHERE s.actv_yn = 'Y'
AND s.last_act_dt < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
AND ( p.session_id IS NULL /* remember-me 토큰이 없는 경우 */
OR p.last_used < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{tokenValiditySeconds} SECOND) /* 토큰이 만료된 경우 */
)
SELECT session_sn, session_id, mbr_id, session_start_dt, session_end_dt, ip_addr, brwsr_info, device_type, os_info, actv_yn, last_act_dt FROM svc_mbr_session WHERE session_sn = #{sn}
